reviews.author: Jonathan Adcock
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about The Auto Glen! Honest, dependable, great pricing, an all around fantastic shop. Good mechanics are hard to find, so if you're in need of some vehicle work, I'll save you some trouble, reach out to the Auto Glen, they'll take good care of ya!

reviews.author: Gary Eggers
reviews.text: In the world of automachanics some have given this trade a bad name. This is one that does just the opposite. Auto Glen is a trustworthy, dependable, honest mechanic that will only do the repairs neccessary to your car or truck. I have taken my car to him on several occasions and have been very satisfied with the results he has given. If something does go wrong with the repairs he is there promptly to take care of it. I am out of state, working, in SC and my wife is in Va. and I am glad I have found someone that I can trust to take care of my repairs while I am gone. Glenn went so far as to make a house call to help find out what was wrong with the car. This is a mechanic you can trust and I will continue to take my vehicles to him for repairs. If you have a GM vehicle then this is the place to go.

reviews.author: Carl Loeffler
reviews.text: Not being from this area I was looking for a good and reliable auto service shop. Looks like I found one.he had to remove entire dash to repair ac problems that a jeep dealership tore up and couldn't fix properly. I'm in this area alot. It's comforting to know where to take my vehicle if another need arises.

reviews.author: UberUrbana
reviews.text: Once again, my second review for The Auto Glen repair shop......This guy has to be the MOST HONEST, UPSTANDING auto repair mechanic I have ever met......and I have had lots in my 60 plus years !!!

reviews.author: Lisa Boyce
reviews.text: Excellant Service. Very thorough in diagnosis and repair. Good, Honest people that go above and beyond, truly care about the work performed. Recommend highly!
